description: Looking to grow Idaho team with fellow nerds
summary: We created a website-based map tool that illustrates the significance and magnitude of trends around the world. It looks at the global scale over the last 46 years to visually identify significant trends across 92 variables. The site is interactive so that variables and map location can be changed by the user, and it is clickable to look at location-specific data. This interactive experience invites the user to explore our world and the scientific trends happening within it.
details: We used the 46 MERRA-2 variables and their intra-month variances to make an interactive experience for users to discover the scientific changes happening in the world around them. The page renders with an opening to give a greater overview of the site, as well as the basics of R^2 and Mann-Kendall. The site illustrates these values through colors and a graph to visually engage the user. We used standard formulas to maintain the validity of each thing represented. The site was built using SvelteKit and TailwindCSS, with the data processing handled by SvelteKit routes as well as Node, with GDAL to read the NetCDF files. We thought about usability and engagement when building the site. We also wanted people to walk away feeling like they learned something. It has stories built in, so a novice user has an easy click to learn more.
